subject: Final collection path for INV-897: card sweep + wire split?
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@clockworklabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Trevor Mills <trevor@clockworklabs.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice INV-897 — PO mismatch and payment options

Hi Mina / Laura,

Apologies for the short notice. We received INV-897 for $38,420 but our AP system has PO 8344 tied to a different Redwood billing entity. Our payment window closes Friday and the card on file has a daily limit that won't cover the full amount. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a split payment (partial card sweep + wire for the balance) and provide wire instructions and remittance details?

I attached PO_8344.pdf and the invoice (Clockwork_INV_897.pdf). We can escalate internally if we need a vendor remittance form or W-9.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Finance Manager
Clockwork Labs
[attachment: Clockwork_INV_897.pdf (invoice, 1 page)]
[attachment: PO_8344.pdf (purchase order, 1 page)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@clockworklabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-897 — PO mismatch and payment options

Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and the PO. Short answer: yes, we can accept a split. Two straightforward paths depending on what your AP prefers:

1) One-time card sweep for up to the card limit, plus wire for the remainder. For the card sweep we can send a Stripe payment link (one-off) or a one-time authorization form if corporate policy requires tokenization.

2) Full wire/ACH payment to Redwood’s bank account — we’ll need the PO mapped to our billing entity (Finance will reconcile on receipt) and a remittance email.

I’m including the wire stub below for immediate planning (please do not use this as final until you confirm entity):
Bank: First Western Bank
Account: Redwood Inference, 987654321
Routing: 111000025
SWIFT: FWBKUS33

Ben — can you confirm whether we can waive the standard $150 late-processing fee if Clockwork executes the split within 48 hours?

Olivia — I attached a short one-time card auth form if your AP needs it. If you prefer a Stripe link, I can send it and track the partial capture so we can route the remaining via wire. Also, we can provide a W-9 if your vendor onboarding team needs it.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: one-time-card-auth-form.pdf (card authorization, 1 page)]

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@clockworklabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Trevor Mills <trevor@clockworklabs.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-897 — PO mismatch and payment options

Thanks Mina — we prefer option 1 (partial card + wire). Trevor just confirmed we can do a card sweep for $12,000 (card limit today) and will wire the remaining $26,420 tomorrow morning. We need your confirmed remittance email and precise payee/bank details to initiate the wire. Also please attach your W-9; our vendor team requires it to complete the payment.

PO mapping: please use PO 8344 and bill to Clockwork Labs / entity ID 772.

Olivia

• We’ll waive the $150 late-processing fee if both payments are executed within 48 hours from the time the card sweep completes.

Stripe link (expires 48 hours): https://pay.stripe.com/link/abc123
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/DocuSign/rooms/12345

Thanks — looping Laura (finance) for reconciliation once funds land.
